items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I was a drummer on those things that she did.

ctx.x: No, I was a drummer on those things that she did. But they know all about that, you know -- then you'll sit up and you'll forget, you know -- I didn't remember recording with Nellie until someone said, "Hurry on Down", you know.

Yeah, because it's another gig, you know -- it's just another day at the factory, just another recording date. But all kinds of things ... Dinah Shore and Benny Goodman sextet. I did the second "The World Is Waiting for the Sunrise" that he did, Benny did, you know, but I did some nice things with Mel Powell, because those were fun things. I kind of liked to reflect on those things, because I got more enjoyment out of those types of recordings than I did the studio, because the studio was almost like canned…
